Instrument (EN): Reactions to Tests Scale — European Portuguese 20-item medical-student psychometric validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Tension (5); Worry (6); Test-Irrelevant Thinking (5); Bodily Symptoms (4). Four first-order subscales and optional second-order general Test Anxiety factor studied.
Research provenance: Pereira DSM, Pereira AM, Castanho TC et al. BMC Psychology 9:166, published 2021-10-27, DOI 10.1186/s40359-021-00656-w. European Portuguese 20-item RTT translation/back-translation, pilot N67, main N672 Portuguese medical students; randomized EFA N336 and CFA N336, four-factor and second-order models, convergent STAI-Y evidence; metric invariance across gender and curricula (NOT scalar invariance).
